map.根据最高法子女抚养司法解释计算抚养费: Computes child support under the Supreme People's Court judicial interpretation on child maintenance
map.📖 查看「抚养费计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Child Support Calculator User Guide"
map.有固定收入者：抚养费 = 月收入 × 20% 至 30%；负担两个以上子女可在上: For a parent with fixed income: support = monthly income × 20% to 30%; with two or more children the rate may rise within the cap but not above 50% of monthly income. For a parent without fixed income, the same ratios apply to that year's total income or the local per-capita disposable income of the previous year. A parent with no income or who has lost earning capacity may pay in kind.
map.按月总收入的20%-30%比例给付；负担两个以上子女的可适当提高，但一般不超过月: Pay 20%-30% of total monthly income; with two or more children the rate may be raised but generally not above 50% of total monthly income
map.依据当年总收入或同行业平均收入，参照上述比例确定: Set by reference to that year's total income or the industry average, at the ratios above
map.一般至子女十八周岁为止；尚在校接受高中及以下学历教育，或丧失/未完全丧失劳动能力: Generally until the child turns 18; parents must continue where the child is still in high school or below, or cannot sustain a normal life for reasons beyond their control such as lost or partially lost earning capacity
map.原定数额不足以维持当地实际生活水平、因子女患病/上学实际需要已超过原定数额等可请: An increase may be sought where the original amount no longer covers the local cost of living, or actual needs such as illness or schooling exceed it
map.协议或诉讼离婚时，按支付方月收入比例估算子女抚养费，确定合理数额。: In divorce by agreement or litigation, estimate support from the paying parent's monthly income to settle a reasonable amount.
map.抚养多个子女时，比例可适当提高但通常不超过月总收入 50%。: For several children the rate may rise but usually stays under 50% of total monthly income.
map.子女患重大疾病等大额支出，可另行主张分担，不限于按月抚养费。: Large outlays such as serious illness may be claimed separately, beyond the monthly support.
map.一孩：支付方月收入 1.5 万元: One child: paying parent earns ¥15,000 a month
map.按 20% 比例，基础抚养费 = 15000 × 20% = 3000 元/月；: At 20%, base support = 15000 × 20% = ¥3,000/month; where local living costs are high, the tool notes that the amount should not fall below the support corresponding to the local minimum living guarantee.
map.同一收入 1.5 万元，两孩按 25% 比例 = 3750 元/月；支付至子女满: On the same ¥15,000 income, two children at 25% = ¥3,750/month; payable until the child turns 18, with years = 18 − current age.
map.抚养费比例有法定标准吗？: Is there a statutory rate for child support?
map.有参照比例：有固定收入的按月总收入 20%–30% 给付，两孩以上一般不超过 5: There are reference ratios: 20%-30% of total monthly income where income is fixed, generally capped at 50% for two or more children; without fixed income, apply the same ratios to that year's total income or the industry average.
map.包括子女生活费、教育费、医疗费等；择校费、大额医疗费等超出基本范围的支出，可协商: It covers living, education and medical expenses; school-choice fees and major medical bills beyond the basics may be shared by agreement or court order.
